state.bit_order: state bit 0 is the least significant bit
state.nibble_order: S-box j acts on state bits 4*j, 4*j+1, 4*j+2, 4*j+3; bit 4*j is the S-box input LSB

permutation.semantics: an input bit at position i is moved to position P[i]

round_function.whitening: X^0 is XORed with RK^0 before round 0
round_function.round_key: RK^r = ROR_128(K, r); round r uses RK^(r+1) after PermBits
round_function.round_constant_placement: for the six-bit constant c, bit j is XORed into state position [8,13,19,35,67,106][j]

integral_structure.inactive_input_positions: all positions 14..127 are fixed but arbitrary
integral_structure.balanced_definition: the XOR sum of a bit over the full structure is zero for every master key and every fixed assignment of inactive input bits

extension_scope.known_state: the output after two additional rounds
extension_scope.guessed_key_indexing: report positions in the 128-bit round subkey entering the last inverse round; use the same LSB-first state indexing
extension_scope.round_constants: known round constants may be absorbed into the guessed round-subkey value when deriving candidate equivalence
